Warranty Information The Long Story This limited edition of the Wylde Audio Overdrive comes bedecked in a special finish inspired by the Berzerker’s tribute band Zakk Sabbath, an homage to the godfathers of heavy metal. On the inside, it’s got the same guts, custom built for Zakk’s loud, tough, and relentless riffs and leads. It’ll transform your amp into a heavy, chunky crunch machine. With a simple Output, Tone, and Gain control layout, setup is fast and easy so that you can concentrate on the important business at hand—kicking major sonic ass. Zakk likes to stick it in front of a dirty amp and kick into full-on screaming lead tones with sustain that lasts for days. Grab the MXR Zakk Sabbath Overdrive while you can, and unleash your six-stringed beast. Take no prisoners.
